headline.family_guess: Helvetica/Arial Bold or similar grotesque (default caption-app font)
headline.size_rel: large, ~7-9% of frame height per line

caption.family_guess: same grotesque bold as headline (single caption style throughout, no separate title card)
caption.size_rel: ~7-9% of frame height, 2 lines max, tight leading
caption.highlight: 1 keyword per line/phrase colored accent yellow (#F5E028), rest white, black stroke ~4-6px on all text

layout.host_pos: centered, face fills upper-2/3 of frame, static camera, no reframing
layout.safe_zones: bottom ~15-20% reserved for 2-line caption block; no other overlays, no logo/watermark, no side UI

transitions: none — single continuous unedited talking-head take for full 35s

themeable: bg (whatever the host's real background is — not art-directed)
